jobs.description:
Votre équipe

La division Corporate Functions regroupe les activités non bancaires du groupe Pictet et compte plus de 800 collaborateurs. Composées de spécialistes maîtrisant parfaitement l’ensemble des lignes de métier, les fonctions centrales s’articulent autour de plusieurs départements: Audit interne, Communication, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finances, Fiscalité, Juridique, Ressources humaines, Risques et Sécurité de l’information.

Basé à Genève, le département Group Tax a pour mission de gérer la situation fiscale du Groupe, en assurant la conformité avec les exigences légales et réglementaires, la gestion des risques fiscaux, la préservation de la réputation de Pictet et le maintien de relations de qualité avec les administrations fiscales.

Group Tax cherche un/e expert/e en fiscalité pour intégrer l’équipe Group Tax Office , chargée principalement du pilotage de projets fiscaux stratégiques au sein du Groupe, de la gestion des risques et des contrôles fiscaux, ainsi que de la coordination en cas de demandes de renseignements ou d’audits.

Votre rôle

• Participer au pilotage des projets fiscaux stratégiques, en apportant votre expertise sur les impôts directs et indirects (impôt anticipé, TVA, droit de timbre), les taxes transactionnelles et l’imposition à la source.

• Mettre en place et réaliser des contrôles et audits fiscaux, formuler des recommandations et suivre leur mise en œuvre.

• Évaluer les risques fiscaux et élaborer des stratégies de mitigation.

• Superviser les processus de classification et de reporting client pour garantir la conformité aux exigences FATCA, CRS et QI, dans le cadre de la transparence fiscale.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les autres départements pour intégrer les aspects fiscaux dans les projets transverses.

• Suivre l’évolution du droit et de la réglementation en matière de fiscalité.

Votre profil

• Diplôme universitaire en droit ou en sciences économiques.

• Expérience de 5 à 10 ans en fiscalité, idéalement acquise en cabinet d’avocats ou dans l’une des « Big Four ».

• Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, en faisant preuve d’esprit d’initiative.

• Excellentes compétences analytiques, sens de la résolution de problèmes et capacité à proposer des améliorations aux pratiques actuelles.

• Maîtrise des applications MS Office usuelles.

• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais ; la connaissance de l’allemand est un atout.

Réf. GTE/LJ/VB

Note

Nous n’accepterons aucun CV transmis par des agences.

Pictet est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances et s’engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons chaque individu et veillons à favoriser leur inclusion au sein de l’entreprise.

Your team

The Corporate Functions division brings together the Pictet Group's non-banking activities and has over 800 employees. The core functions, which are made up of specialists with a perfect mastery of all business lines, are structured around several departments: Internal Audit, Communication, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Taxation, Legal, Human Resources, Risk and Information Security.

Based in Geneva, the Group Tax department is responsible for managing the Group's tax situation, ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, managing tax risks, preserving Pictet's reputation and maintaining good relations with tax administrations.

Group Tax is looking for a tax expert to join the Group Tax Office team, which is primarily responsible for the management of strategic tax projects within the Group, risk management and tax controls, as well as coordination in case of enquiries or audits.

Your role

• Participate in the management of strategic tax projects, bringing your expertise on direct and indirect taxes (early tax, VAT, stamp duty), transactional taxes and tax at source.

• Establish and carry out fiscal controls and audits, make recommendations and monitor their implementation.

• Assess tax risks and develop mitigation strategies.

• Supervise customer classification and reporting processes to ensure compliance with FATCA, CRS and IQ requirements as part of tax transparency.

• Work closely with other departments to integrate tax aspects into cross-cutting projects.

• Monitor developments in tax law and regulation.

Your profile

• University degree in law or economics.

• 5 to 10 years of experience in taxation, ideally acquired in law firms or in one of the "Big Four".

• Ability to work independently, with initiative.

• Excellent analytical skills, sense of problem solving and ability to propose improvements to current practices.

• Mastery of common MS Office applications.

• Excellent mastery of French and English; knowledge of German is an asset.

Ref. GTE/LJ/VB

Note

We will not accept any CVs transmitted by agencies.

Die Steuerabteilung des Konzerns mit Sitz in Genf ist verantwortlich für die Steuerung der Steuersituation des Konzerns, die Gewährleistung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Anforderungen, das Management von Steuerrisiken, die Wahrung des Rufs von Pictet und die Aufrechterhaltung guter Beziehungen zu Steuerverwaltungen.

Gruppe Tax sucht einen Steuerexperten für das Team des Konzernfinanzamts, das in erster Linie für das Management strategischer Steuerprojekte innerhalb des Konzerns, Risikomanagement und Steuerkontrollen sowie die Koordination bei Anfragen oder Prüfungen zuständig ist.

Deine Rolle

• Nehmen Sie an der Verwaltung von strategischen Steuerprojekten teil und bringen Sie Ihre Expertise zu direkten und indirekten Steuern (Frühsteuer, Mehrwertsteuer, Stempelsteuer), Transaktionssteuern und Steuern an der Quelle ein.

• Einrichtung und Durchführung von Steuerkontrollen und -prüfungen, Abgabe von Empfehlungen und Überwachung ihrer Umsetzung.

• Bewerten Sie Steuerrisiken und entwickeln Sie Minderungsstrategien.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Kundenklassifizierungs- und Berichtsprozesse, um die Einhaltung der FATCA-, CRS- und IQ-Anforderungen im Rahmen der Steuertransparenz sicherzustellen.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen, um steuerliche Aspekte in Querschnittsprojekte zu integrieren.

• Beobachten Sie die Entwicklungen im Steuerrecht und in der Steuerregulierung.

Dein Profil

• Universitätsabschluss in Recht oder Wirtschaft.

• 5 bis 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Besteuerung, idealerweise erworben in Anwaltskanzleien oder in einer der "Big Four".

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten, mit Initiative.

• Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten, Sinn für Problemlösung und die Fähigkeit, Verbesserungen der aktuellen Praktiken vorzuschlagen.

• Beherrschung von gängigen MS Office-Anwendungen.

• Hervorragende Beherrschung von Französisch und Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Gewinn.

Ref. GTE/LJ/VB

Wir akzeptieren keine von Agenturen übermittelten Lebensläufe.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Fixed-term contract - 12 months)
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

We are seeking a DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer to strengthen the reliability and performance of the bank’s strategic application processes through an advanced monitoring and observability framework across both on-premises and cloud environments. Monitoring is designed and implemented in close cooperation with software engineering teams in order to track end-to-end application chains. Industrialize application and business‑process deployments by designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure production releases and a stable IT production environment.. Participation in a periodic 24/7 on-call shift is required.

Your role

• Provide support to operations teams. Lead post-incident reviews, including Root Cause Analysis and post-mortems. Define and track preventive action plans.

• Collaborate with business and technical teams to align system reliability with operational needs and produce clear operational documentation.

• Industrialize and standardize the deployment of applications and business processes through automated CI/CD pipelines.

• Design, implement and maintain monitoring and observability solutions for business processes, including dashboards, reliability indicators, alerting and end-to-end flow traceability, with advanced use of the Grafana Observability Stack across on-premises systems and cloud services.

• Analyze business-process performance and recommend improvements.

• Integrate new processing tasks into the production schedule and/or optimize existing ones.

• Configure and implement data transfers with external partners, ensuring reliability, traceability and end-to-end monitoring.

• Contribute to the cloud strategy, including deployments, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

• Automate recurring tasks through scripts, workflows and tooling in collaboration with development and operations teams

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and data-protection requirements.

Your profile

• Master's degree / Engineering degree in Computer science

• Fluent in french and english

• Minimum 7 years of experience in a similar role, ideally within a banking environment or fund administration

• Strong expertise in monitoring and observability tools, as well as distributed tracing concepts (Grafana, Dynatrace, Jaeger).

• Good knowledge of cloud environments from major providers (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), with a sound understanding of IaaS, PaaS and SaaS service models.

• Solid knowledge enabling effective use of Kubernetes and Docker infrastructures, including operations, scaling and monitoring.

• Proven hands-on experience with scripting and automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell, orchestration tools).

• Working knowledge of systems and networking (Linux/Unix, Windows Server, core networking fundamentals) to support diagnosis and troubleshooting, without acting as a day-to-day system administrator.

• Familiarity with DevOps concepts and Site Reliability Engineering practices, including reliability indicators, capacity management and scalability.

• Good command of SQL and ability to work with data in Oracle, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) databases, as well as sound knowledge of Prometheus for metrics collection and analysis.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, ability to remain composed during critical incidents, strong communication skills (including in English), and the ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-specialists.

• Strong team spirit and ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including business teams, IT teams and external partners.

• Good knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change and Configuration Management), with the ability to apply them pragmatically in a critical IT production environment.

• Understanding of business processes related to fund administration / transfer agency and the associated regulatory framework.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 30 sedi in centri finanziari in tutto il mondo, e attualmente impiega oltre 5200 persone. Pictet è presente dal 1989 a Lussemburgo, dove occupa oltre 700 persone.

La divisione Pictet Tech è specializzata nella progettazione e integrazione di applicazioni software all'avanguardia, tra cui sistemi avanzati di gestione del portafoglio, piattaforme di trading sofisticate e soluzioni bancarie e aziendali complete. La divisione svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella guida delle innovazioni trasformative che migliorano i nostri servizi e offrono un valore eccezionale ai nostri clienti.

Stiamo cercando un DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer per rafforzare l'affidabilità e le prestazioni dei processi di applicazione strategici della banca attraverso un framework avanzato di monitoraggio e osservabilità in ambienti on-premise e cloud. Il monitoraggio è progettato e implementato in stretta collaborazione con i team di ingegneria del software per monitorare le catene di applicazioni end-to-end. Industrializzare le implementazioni delle applicazioni e dei processi aziendali progettando, implementando e mantenendo le tubazioni CI/CD, garantendo release di produzione sicure e un ambiente di produzione IT stabile. È richiesta la partecipazione a un turno periodico 24 ore su 24.

Il tuo ruolo

• Fornire supporto alle squadre operative. Guida recensioni post-incidenti, tra cui l'analisi delle cause di radice e post-mortems. Definire e monitorare i piani di azione preventiva.

• Collabora con i team aziendali e tecnici per allineare l'affidabilità del sistema con le esigenze operative e produrre una chiara documentazione operativa.

• Industrializzare e standardizzare l'implementazione di applicazioni e processi aziendali attraverso pipeline CI/CD automatizzate.

• Progettare, implementare e mantenere soluzioni di monitoraggio e osservabilità per i processi aziendali, tra cui dashboard, indicatori di affidabilità, allerta e tracciabilità del flusso end-to-end, con uso avanzato del Grafana Observability Stack attraverso sistemi on-premises e servizi cloud.

• Analizzare le prestazioni del business-process e consigliare miglioramenti.

• Integrare i nuovi compiti di lavorazione nel programma di produzione e/o ottimizzare quelli esistenti.

• Configurare e implementare i trasferimenti di dati con partner esterni, garantendo affidabilità, tracciabilità e monitoraggio end-to-end.

• Contribuisci alla strategia cloud, incluse implementazioni, scalabilità, resilienza, disaster recovery e pianificazione della continuità aziendale.

• Automatizzare le attività ricorrenti attraverso script, workflow e tooling in collaborazione con team di sviluppo e operazioni

• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e di protezione dei dati.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea Magistrale / Laurea in Ingegneria in Informatica

• Fluente in francese e inglese

• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente bancario o amministrazione di fondi

• Forte competenza nel monitoraggio e negli strumenti di osservazione, così come i concetti di tracciamento distribuiti (Grafana, Dynatrace, Jaeger).

• Buona conoscenza degli ambienti cloud dei principali provider (AWS, Azure, o equivalente), con una solida comprensione dei modelli di servizi IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.

• Conoscenza solida che consente un uso efficace delle infrastrutture Kubernetes e Docker, comprese operazioni, scaling e monitoraggio.

• Provata esperienza pratica con script e automazione (Shell, Python, PowerShell, strumenti di orchestrazione).

• Conoscenze di lavoro di sistemi e networking (Linux/Unix, Windows Server, fondamentali di rete di base) per supportare la diagnosi e la risoluzione dei problemi, senza agire come amministratore di sistema di giorno per giorno.

• Familiarità con i concetti DevOps e le pratiche di Site Reliability Engineering, inclusi indicatori di affidabilità, gestione della capacità e scalabilità.

• Buon comando di SQL e la capacità di lavorare con i dati in database Oracle, PostgreSQL e Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL), nonché la conoscenza sonora di Prometheus per la raccolta e l'analisi delle metriche.

• Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze, capacità di rimanere composto durante incidenti critici, forti capacità di comunicazione (compreso in inglese), e la capacità di spiegare argomenti tecnici chiaramente ai non specialisti.

• Forte spirito di squadra e capacità di collaborare con una vasta gamma di stakeholder, tra cui team aziendali, team IT e partner esterni.

• Buona conoscenza dei processi ITIL (Incident, Problem, Change and Configuration Management), con la capacità di applicarli pragmaticamente in un ambiente di produzione IT critico.

• Comprensione dei processi aziendali relativi alla gestione dei fondi / agenzia di trasferimento e al quadro normativo associato.

Wir suchen einen DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, um die Zuverlässigkeit und Leistung der strategischen Anwendungsprozesse der Bank durch ein fortschrittliches Monitoring- und Beobachtbarkeits-Framework sowohl vor Ort als auch in Cloud-Umgebungen zu stärken. Industrialisierung von Anwendungs- und Geschäftsprozess-Bereitstellungen durch Entwurf, Implementierung und Wartung von CI/CD-Pipelines, Gewährleistung sicherer Produktionsfreigaben und einer stabilen IT-Produktionsumgebung. Die Teilnahme an einer periodischen 24/7 Bereitschaftsschicht ist erforderlich.

• Unterstützung der Einsatzteams. Führen Sie Post-Incident-Bewertungen, einschließlich Root Cause Analysis und Post-Mortems. Definieren und verfolgen Sie Präventionspläne.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Geschäfts- und Technikteams zusammen, um die Zuverlässigkeit des Systems an den betrieblichen Anforderungen auszurichten und eine klare Betriebsdokumentation zu erstellen.

• Industrialisierung und Standardisierung der Bereitstellung von Anwendungen und Geschäftsprozessen durch automatisierte CI/CD-Pipelines.

• Entwerfen, Implementieren und Pflegen von Überwachungs- und Beobachtbarkeitslösungen für Geschäftsprozesse, einschließlich Dashboards, Zuverlässigkeitsindikatoren, Alarmierung und End-to-End-Flow-Rückverfolgbarkeit, mit fortschrittlichem Einsatz des Grafana Observability Stack für lokale Systeme und Cloud-Dienste.

• Integrieren Sie neue Bearbeitungsaufgaben in den Produktionsplan und/oder optimieren Sie bestehende.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung regulatorischer und datenschutzrechtlicher Anforderungen.

jobs.description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

You will join the Risk & Compliance Data Office, which aims to be the trusted and innovative data partner for the Group’s Risk & Compliance community. The unit empowers informed decision making and proactive risk management through cutting edge technology, scalable platforms and high-quality data. Its mission is to deliver reliable, well-governed and forward-looking data solutions that meet evolving regulatory requirements, foster data driven insights and enable confident, strategic decision making.

This position will initially focus more strongly on data engineering, supporting the evolution of Risk & Compliance data platforms and the migration of data and analytics capabilities to Snowflake. As with all Analytics Engineers, the role is expected to evolve over time in response to business needs and team priorities.

Your role

• Working with risk managers, compliance officers and executive leadership to translate strategic goals and regulatory requirements into robust, high-quality data products, including analytics, dashboards and reporting solutions.
• Acting as a trusted data advisor to stakeholders, providing guidance and support to ensure effective use of analytics and reporting, while translating ambiguous business requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications.
• Taking end-to-end ownership of business themes by proactively driving initiatives that align data solutions with business needs and deliver measurable value, from data source to executive insight.
• Developing the architecture and managing the end-to-end value chain for risk and compliance data verticals, ensuring that the resulting analytics and reports can be used across the Group.
• Designing and rolling out precise, executive-ready metrics and interactive dashboards that stand up to regulatory scrutiny and support the Group’s strategic risk posture.
• Driving the modernisation and streamlining of legacy business logic by migrating and automating solutions into modern data architectures and cloud platforms, as well as implementing innovative approaches, such as AI, intelligent agents and automation, to enhance analytics capabilities.
• Ensuring rigorous data quality and controls in line with the Group's data governance framework in order to maintain the integrity of mission-critical risk and compliance data.
• Managing high-volume, time-sensitive ad hoc requests and complex regulatory reports autonomously and resiliently.
• Proactively engaging with stakeholders to anticipate their needs, identifying opportunities for data-driven improvements and championing best practices in analytics and reporting.
• Contributing to cross-functional initiatives to align the Risk & Compliance community and the Group on data governance, data strategy, data literacy and best practices.

Your profile

• A master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related field. Advanced certifications (e.g. FRM or CFA) would be a plus.
• At least five years’ experience in a high impact data role, such as Data Engineering, Data Analytics or AI/ML, including hands-on expertise.
• Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python, including the design, maintenance and orchestration of modern ETL/ELT workflows.
• Experience with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms would be a strong asset.
• Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Tableau, Power BI or equivalent.
• Knowledge of risk management, compliance, banking operations and/or regulatory reporting would be an advantage.
• Entrepreneurial and “can‑do” attitude, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced matrix environment.
• Strong communication, problem solving, organisational, interpersonal and project management skills.
• Excellent command of French and English, both written and spoken.
• Must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate.

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

L'unità abilita il processo decisionale informato e la gestione del rischio proattiva attraverso tecnologie all'avanguardia, piattaforme scalabili e dati di alta qualità. La sua missione è quella di fornire soluzioni di dati affidabili, ben governate e previsionali che soddisfino i requisiti normativi in evoluzione, favoriscano le intuizioni basate sui dati e consentono un processo decisionale sicuro e strategico.

Questa posizione si concentrerà inizialmente più fortemente sull'ingegneria dei dati, supportando l'evoluzione delle piattaforme di dati Risk & Compliance e la migrazione di dati e funzionalità di analisi a Snowflake. Come per tutti gli ingegneri di analisi, il ruolo dovrebbe evolversi nel tempo in risposta alle esigenze aziendali e alle priorità del team.

Il tuo ruolo

• Lavorare con i responsabili del rischio, gli agenti di conformità e la leadership esecutiva per tradurre obiettivi strategici e requisiti normativi in prodotti di dati robusti e di alta qualità, tra cui analisi, dashboard e soluzioni di reporting.
• Agire come consulente di dati di fiducia per le parti interessate, fornire guida e supporto per garantire un uso efficace di analisi e reportistica, traducendo i requisiti aziendali ambigui in specifiche tecniche chiare e attuabili.
• Prendendo la proprietà end-to-end di temi aziendali guidando proattivamente iniziative che allineano le soluzioni di dati con le esigenze aziendali e di fornire valore misurabile, dalla fonte di dati alla comprensione esecutiva.

• Progettare e implementare metriche precise e corrette e dashboard interattivi che si allineano al controllo normativo e supportano la postura strategica del Gruppo.
• Guidare l'ammodernamento e lo snellimento della logica aziendale legacy migrando e automatizzando le soluzioni nelle moderne architetture di dati e piattaforme cloud, oltre a implementare approcci innovativi, come l'AI, gli agenti intelligenti e l'automazione, per migliorare le capacità di analisi.
• Garantire una rigorosa qualità dei dati e controlli in linea con il quadro di governance dei dati del Gruppo al fine di mantenere l'integrità dei dati di rischio e conformità mission-critical.
• Gestire richieste ad hoc ad-sensibili ad alto volume, tempo e complesse relazioni normative in modo autonomo e resiliente.
• Impegnarsi attivamente con gli stakeholder per anticipare le loro esigenze, identificare le opportunità per migliorare i dati e sostenere le migliori pratiche nell'analisi e nella reportistica.
• Contribuire a iniziative interfunzionali per allineare la comunità Risk & Compliance e il Gruppo sulla governance dei dati, la strategia dei dati, l'alfabetizzazione dei dati e le migliori pratiche.

Il tuo profilo

• Un master in Data Analytics, Informatica, Finanza, Ingegneria o un campo correlato. Certificazioni avanzate (ad esempio FRM o CFA) sarebbero un vantaggio.
• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza in un ruolo di dati ad alto impatto, come Data Engineering, Data Analytics o AI/ML, comprese le competenze pratiche.
• Competenza a livello di esperti in SQL e Python, tra cui la progettazione, la manutenzione e l'orchestrazione dei moderni flussi di lavoro ETL/ELT.
• L'esperienza con Snowflake e le moderne piattaforme di dati cloud-based sarebbe un bene forte.
• Esperienza con le piattaforme di business intelligence e reporting come Tableau, Power BI o equivalente.
• La conoscenza della gestione del rischio, della conformità, delle operazioni bancarie e/o dei rapporti normativi sarebbe un vantaggio.

Sa mission est d'offrir des solutions de données fiables, bien gérées et tournées vers l'avenir qui répondent à des exigences réglementaires changeantes, de favoriser des connaissances fondées sur les données et de permettre la prise de décisions stratégiques confiantes.

Cette position se concentrera d'abord plus fortement sur l'ingénierie des données, en soutenant l'évolution des plateformes de données de risque et de conformité et la migration des capacités de données et d'analyse vers Snowflake.
